request.style: English, female solo voice, bright and gentle, acoustic guitar, piano, celesta, soft strings, cheerful and wonder-filled, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth
The earth was formless and empty darkness lay over the deep
The Spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters
And then God spoke the words that set the world in motion

[Pre-Chorus]
And God said let there be light
And there was light
He saw that the light was good
And separated it from the dark

[Chorus]
Let there be light in the vault of the heavens
Let them shine on the earth from the sky
God saw all that he had made
And behold it was very good

[Verse]
He made the two great lights to govern the day and the night
He made the stars to shine in the vault of the heavens
He set them to separate the light from the darkness
And God saw that it was good and the days began

[Pre-Chorus]
Let the waters under the heavens be gathered into one place
Let the dry ground appear and God called it land
He called the gathered waters seas and saw that it was good
And the dry land appeared under the wide blue sky

[Chorus]
Let there be light in the vault of the heavens
Let them shine on the earth from the sky
God saw all that he had made
And behold it was very good

[Verse]
Then God said let us make man in our image according to our likeness
So God created man in his own image in the image of God
He created them male and female and blessed them greatly
Saying be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it

[Pre-Chorus]
I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth
Every tree that bears fruit with seed in it will be your food
And to every wild animal and every bird of the sky
I give every green plant for food and it was so

[Chorus]
Let there be light in the vault of the heavens
Let them shine on the earth from the sky
God saw all that he had made
And behold it was very good

[Outro]
And there was evening and there was morning
The sixth day
And on the seventh day he rested
